hints.title: Greedy Leftmost Digits
hints.text: To minimize an integer, place the smallest possible digit as far left as possible.

hints.title: Digit Candidate Queue
hints.text: Maintain queues storing original indices for each digit 0 through 9.

hints.title: Binary Indexed Tree Shift Tracking
hints.text: When moving a digit to the current position, calculate its actual displacement by querying how many preceding digits were already shifted.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating physical array shifts takes O(N^2) time, which times out for N = 30000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A Fenwick tree computes dynamic shifted index offsets in O(log N) per chosen digit.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates greedy digit selection coupled with a Fenwick tree to track prefix deletions efficiently.
complexity.notes: Digits checked in ascending order 0 to 9.
